2. And the Tile admin screen is open for UI-ADMIN-01; fixture record 101 is inactive and has Tile Name Fixture Tile; its owner is TEST_OWNER; Application Category Fixture Category is selected; the create response is a record with applicationTileId 102 and Tile Name Changed Tile
3. When Admin A clicks button named "Create New Tile" inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel
4. And Admin A enters "Changed Tile" into textbox named "Tile Name" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel
5. And Admin A enters "Demo" into textbox named "Description" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel
6. And Admin A enters "/test" into textbox named "Module Path" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel
7. And Admin A enters "/test-entry" into textbox named "Tile Path" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel

10. And Admin A enters "support@example.test" into textbox named "Email Support" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel
11. And Admin A enters "7" into spinbutton named "Order No" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel
12. And Admin A enters "Global" into textbox named "Entry Name" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel
13. And Admin A opens combobox named "Container" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel
14. And Admin A clicks option named "@fm/test" inside the popup for the "Container" combobox in the new Tile dialog
15. And Admin A opens combobox named "Image URL for Dark Theme" inside the new-record dialog inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel
